payload.core_composition_summary: DP on value index states computing counts for increasing subsequence lengths, accelerated by Fenwick tree range sums.
payload.rationale: Solution uses dynamic programming where each length layer is a 1D state over sequence values. Fenwick tree enables efficient prefix sum queries and updates in O(log n), essential for n=1e5.
